topics.briefDescription: External screens designed to extend the display area of a laptop, providing additional screen real estate for various tasks. These monitors are lightweight, easy to set up, and offer multiple connectivity options, making them versatile for different uses. They are ideal for multitasking, professional work, and gaming, catering to users who need more screen space on the go.

Free and open-source software designed for creating and animating sprites. It offers tools specifically tailored for pixel art and animation, making it a valuable resource for game developers and digital artists. The primary users of LibreSprite are game developers and digital artists focused on pixel art and sprite animations.

Platform offering high-quality 2D game assets for various projects, including game icons, sprites, tilesets, GUI elements, and characters. Craftpix distinguishes itself by providing both affordable and free game assets, catering to a wide range of game development needs. The platform primarily targets game developers and designers seeking cost-effective and visually appealing graphics for their projects.

Brand or store specializing in keychains, offering a variety of designs and possibly custom options. Keypop differentiates itself by providing unique and customizable keychain designs that cater to various tastes and preferences. The target demographic includes individuals looking for personalized accessories and gifts, as well as keychain enthusiasts.

A couch tray is a portable surface designed to rest securely on a couch arm or seat, providing a stable platform for holding items such as drinks, snacks, or electronics. Often made from wood, plastic, or flexible materials, it is designed to fit snugly on various couch arm shapes, offering convenience without taking up floor space. Couch trays are primarily targeted at individuals seeking a practical and space-efficient solution for enjoying food, drinks, or entertainment essentials while relaxing on their couch.

A company founded in 2007 in Tucson, AZ, that creates merchandise inspired by popular video games. Fangamer offers a wide range of products including shirts, plushes, figures, books, prints, pins, and stickers, distinguishing itself with high-quality, officially licensed items that appeal to gaming enthusiasts. The target demographic for Fangamer includes fans of popular video games who are looking for unique and well-crafted merchandise to express their fandom.

Adventure platform that transforms cities into personal playgrounds, offering a variety of fun and engaging activities. Questo differentiates itself by providing interactive, self-guided tours and quests that combine elements of exploration, learning, and entertainment, enhancing the travel experience. It is designed for solo travelers, couples, families, and friends seeking unique and memorable adventures in urban environments.

Marketing agency based in Uppsala, Sweden, specializing in gaming influencer marketing. Wehype provides scalable, accessible, and effortless solutions to help game publishers and brands reach gaming communities worldwide, differentiating itself by connecting creators with games. Their services are primarily targeted at game publishers and brands looking to leverage influencer marketing to engage with gaming audiences.

Platform that provides tools and analytics for gamers, particularly those who play competitive games like Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO). It helps players improve their skills by analyzing their gameplay, offering insights, and suggesting areas for improvement through advanced algorithms. The platform is primarily targeted at competitive gamers seeking to enhance their performance and gain a deeper understanding of their gameplay.

Platform where users can virtually track their game collection, keep their backlog updated, rate the games they've played, and add upcoming games to their wishlist. It differentiates itself by providing a comprehensive and user-friendly interface for managing and reviewing video game collections, enhancing the gaming experience through community engagement and personalized recommendations. Backloggd primarily targets gamers who want to organize their game libraries, share their gaming experiences, and discover new titles.

Software that provides a network-based Software Development Kit (SDK) for controlling RGB lighting across various devices. OpenRGB supports game integrations, music visualization, ambient lighting, and more, with SDK bindings available for multiple programming languages such as C++, Python, C#, and Java. It is particularly useful for developers and enthusiasts looking to synchronize RGB lighting across different hardware and software environments.

A fast-growing digital entertainment supplier operating in 23 regulated markets with over 200 partners worldwide. The company offers a diverse portfolio of online casino games, known for their engaging mathematical design and appealing aesthetics, setting it apart from competitors. Playson primarily targets online casino operators and players seeking high-quality, engaging gaming experiences.

Slovenian video game developer known for creating the Talking Tom & Friends app and media franchise. The company differentiates itself by producing interactive and engaging mobile games that have garnered a large global user base, particularly among younger audiences. Outfit7 primarily targets children and casual gamers who enjoy character-driven, interactive entertainment.

Japanese entertainment and gaming company founded in 1969, known for developing and publishing a variety of video games, trading card games, anime, tokusatsu, slot machines, and arcade cabinets. It differentiates itself with famous video game franchises such as 'Metal Gear,' 'Silent Hill,' 'Castlevania,' 'Contra,' and 'Pro Evolution Soccer,' which have garnered a significant following. Konami primarily targets gamers and entertainment enthusiasts worldwide, offering a diverse range of products and experiences.

A 3D modeling program designed for creating and editing low-poly models, particularly for use in Minecraft. It is widely used by Minecraft modders and resource pack creators to design custom models and animations, supporting various formats and offering features like texture painting, animation, and model exporting. Blockbench primarily benefits game developers, modders, and digital artists who focus on Minecraft content creation.

Online marketplace that caters to independent digital creators, particularly those developing indie video games. Itch.io provides a platform for developers to upload, distribute, and sell their games and other digital content, offering flexible pricing models and participation in game jams and bundles. The platform primarily benefits indie game developers and digital content creators seeking a supportive and flexible marketplace to reach their audience.

Brand specializing in gaming accessories, particularly chargers for gaming controllers. Oivo offers a variety of products designed to enhance the gaming experience, including chargers for Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and other gaming controllers, differentiating itself with reliable and convenient charging solutions. The target demographic includes gamers seeking dependable and efficient charging options for their gaming controllers.

Major antagonist in the manga/anime series 'Jujutsu Kaisen,' known as a special grade Cursed Spirit. Jogo, along with other Cursed Spirits, aims to destroy humanity and create a society where Cursed Spirits will dominate, showcasing his immense power and malevolence. The character primarily appeals to fans of the series who are interested in the darker, more sinister elements of the story.

Tabletop role-playing games (TTRPGs) are a form of game where players assume the roles of characters in a fictional setting, guided by a set of rules and a game master. These games emphasize storytelling, character development, and collaborative problem-solving, often using dice and other tools to determine the outcomes of actions. TTRPGs appeal to individuals who enjoy immersive storytelling, creative expression, and social interaction in a structured yet imaginative environment.

Entertainment company based in Tel Aviv, Israel, specializing in the development of multiplayer match-3 games. Candivore differentiates itself by focusing on engaging, social gaming experiences that connect players worldwide through competitive and cooperative gameplay. The company's primary audience includes casual gamers and fans of puzzle games who enjoy interactive and social gaming experiences.

Noping is the present participle of 'nope,' used informally to express a strong or humorous refusal or rejection. It is often employed in casual conversations or online interactions to convey a decisive or emphatic 'no' in a lighthearted manner. Noping is typically used by individuals seeking to add a playful or humorous tone to their refusals or rejections.

Project that creates highly detailed, 3D models of the human brain at microscopic resolution. It is the first openly accessible model of its kind, providing valuable data for scientific research and advancing our understanding of the human brain. The BigBrain project primarily benefits neuroscientists, researchers, and medical professionals seeking detailed anatomical data for their studies.

A spoofer is a tool or technique used to deceive or manipulate data, signals, or identities in various contexts, particularly in technology, cybersecurity, and telecommunications. It includes methods like email spoofing, IP spoofing, DNS spoofing, GPS spoofing, caller ID spoofing, and MAC address spoofing, often employed in malicious activities to gain unauthorized access, steal data, or spread malware. Spoofers are typically used by cybercriminals and hackers to exploit vulnerabilities and carry out fraudulent activities.

Vehicle simulation game that uses soft-body physics to simulate realistic vehicle dynamics and collisions. It features highly detailed and accurate physics algorithms optimized for realistic vehicle behavior, providing an immersive driving experience. The game is popular among simulation enthusiasts who seek a high level of realism in vehicle dynamics and collisions.

Platform that has reinvented the way gamers enhance their gaming experience by offering services such as traditional boosting and allowing users to buy and sell in-game items and services. Overgear differentiates itself by providing a comprehensive marketplace for gamers to improve their gaming time through various options, including skill enhancement and item acquisition. The platform primarily targets gamers looking to optimize their in-game performance and overall experience.

British gambling company founded in 1972, headquartered in Nuneaton, UK. It operates over 148 high street venues and has an online presence, offering services such as slot machines, electronic roulette, and other gaming machines, distinguishing itself with a wide range of gaming options. The company primarily targets adults seeking entertainment through gambling activities.

Tool used for applying post-processing effects to games and other 3D applications. It enhances the visual quality of these applications by allowing users to add various effects such as color correction, depth of field, and ambient occlusion, differentiating itself by its extensive customization options. Reshade is primarily targeted at gamers and developers looking to improve the visual aesthetics of their applications.

A neutral marketplace that facilitates player-to-player trading for a variety of popular online games. It supports trading for games such as RuneScape, World of Warcraft, CSGO, and many others, providing a secure platform for buying and selling in-game items, accounts, and currencies. Playerauctions primarily targets gamers looking to enhance their gaming experience through the acquisition of virtual goods and services.

Aimlabs is an aim-training shooter game developed and published by State Space Labs, Inc., designed to help players practice and optimize their gameplay in first or third-person shooter settings. It differentiates itself by incorporating insights from neuroscientists, designers, developers, and computer vision experts, offering a scientifically-backed approach to improving aim and reaction times. The game primarily targets gamers looking to enhance their shooting skills, available on platforms such as Microsoft Windows, Android, and iOS.

Splendor is a popular board game where players take on the roles of Renaissance merchants aiming to acquire the most prestige points. The game involves collecting gems and developing trade routes to build a prosperous business, with strategic planning and resource management being key elements. Splendor is primarily enjoyed by board game enthusiasts and families looking for a strategic and engaging game experience.

PatchBot is a Discord bot designed to deliver patch notes and game updates directly to channels. It organizes updates into specific threads, allows role mentions for notifications, automatically pins updates, and offers customization options for selecting which games to follow, providing a streamlined way to stay informed about game changes. PatchBot is particularly useful for gaming communities and Discord server administrators who want to keep their members updated on the latest game developments efficiently.
